author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Loyalty Data Audit
challenge.description: A legal audit flagged that loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, breaking the legal basis for using it in forecasts. #requirements_reuben# demands the data contracts be fully automated and governed to enforce consent checks before any data enters the pipeline. #efficiency_emilia# argues that manual review is sufficient for now to avoid delaying the promotion planning cycle, though she might accept a middle ground if it does not stall the weekly leaflet.

output.content: The audit findings force a hard choice on where we spend our engineering hours. I am prepared to leave the KPI definitions entirely manual, with no automated validation or governance layer, for the foreseeable future. That saves us significant time and complexity. In exchange, I require the data contracts to be fully automated and governed. Every loyalty basket record must pass a strict consent check before it enters the pipeline. If the contract automation slips, the legal basis for the entire forecast collapses. I am not interested in partial measures. We secure the data entry point first, and we accept the manual KPI process as the cost of that security.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly accepts giving up automated KPI governance to secure fully automated data contracts, defining a specific exchange between two capabilities.
